comment: ANCHOR: ROTATE_FILLED_TRANCHE_1689_20261109 — the Home rotation card knows what the book already holds
(LQ-20261107-1689). A position of >=90% of the planned tranche-1 shares marks that tranche FILLED with the held
shares/avg/date, the cash-after line stops deducting a tranche that was already paid for, and the next step is
Tranche 2 after the CIO's own catalyst label. No fill is claimed without a real held quantity and a live share count.
